display_name: Urbz, The - Sims in the City (USA, Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl)

slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Global header + main save struct sector. Loaded first: 24-byte header at +0 must have magic URBZ0011 and u16_le word-sum over 0x00-0x17 == 0 (FUN_0804d694 via FUN_0804d6f0). If invalid, the whole used area is re-initialised blank (FUN_0804da48 + zeroed sector writes). No backup/mirror copy exists.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_1
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Read by FUN_0804d9e4/FUN_0804d938 into the 0x1000 buffer; valid iff u16_le word-sum over the whole sector == 0 (FUN_0804d9b4/FUN_0804da24). Valid: deserialised into RAM entry 0 (0x2C bytes) by FUN_08023e3c. Invalid: entry zeroed. All-zero is a valid empty block. Structural label only; not proven to be a player-facing save slot.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_2
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Same rule as slot_1, RAM entry 1 (FUN_0804d938 loop index 1).

slots_and_copies.name: slot_3
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Same rule as slot_1, RAM entry 2 (FUN_0804d938 loop index 2).

slots_and_copies.name: slot_4
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Same rule as slot_1, RAM entry 3 (FUN_0804d938 loop index 3).

slots_and_copies.name: unused_flash
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Erased 0xFF in both samples; no traced reader or writer touches offsets >= 0x5000.

checksums.name: header_sum16_zero
checksums.formula_detail: s = sum of u16_le words over bytes 0x00-0x17 (12 words) modulo 65536 must equal 0. Stored word at 0x0E (word index 7) = (-sum of the other 11 words) modulo 65536; writers zero it, sum, then negate (FUN_0804da24 core).

checksums.name: sector1_4_sum16_zero
checksums.formula_detail: Sum of u16_le words over the full 0x1000-byte sector must equal 0 (FUN_0804d9b4 requires FUN_0804da24(buffer, 0x1000) == 0). No distinct stored field located; an all-zero sector satisfies it trivially. Location of the compensating word in a non-empty sector is unknown because no writer was traced.

io_driver_functions.notes: Flash identify: AA/55 unlock at 0x0E000000+0x5555/0x2AAA, command 0x90, reads ID bytes via IWRAM trampoline 0x0806bd28, reset 0xF0 x2; returns (manufacturer<<8)|device.
Selects flash descriptor: calls identify 0x0806b3c8, walks descriptor table matching ID at entry+0x28, copies 5xu32 + pointer at +0x14 into globals; sets WAITCNT-style register |3.
Sector erase (sector < 0x10): AA/55/80/AA/55/30 sequence to 0x0E000000+(sector<<shift from descriptor+8), poll via 0x0806bd20. No direct static caller; reached via IWRAM trampoline 0x0806bd1c.
Program single byte: AA/55/A0, *dest=*src, poll via 0x0806bd20. No direct static caller; IWRAM trampoline only.
Read flash bytes from 0x0E000000+(sector<<shift)+off via 0x0806bd20 copy trampoline; bank-switches via 0x0806b3a4 only when flash-size global == 0x20000 (Flash 1M path, not this title's 512K).
Copies an SDK code range to a RAM/stack buffer so flash routines can run from RAM during programming.
Begin flash access: saves wait-state registers, sets mode 2 via 0x0806b48c, returns success flag. Paired restore is 0x0800d8bc.
Read len bytes at flash offset into RAM in 0x1000 chunks via 0x0806b61c (offset>>12 = sector).
Flash write wrapper ( distinct from game stream function at 0x0804d800): writes len>>12 whole sectors, up to 3 retries per sector via trampoline 0x0806bd1c, advancing source by 0x1000.
sum16_le core: s16 sum of (len>>1) u16_le words from pointer, 16-bit wrap.
Verify header: read 0x18 bytes at flash 0, require 12-word sum == 0, then 8-byte URBZ0011 compare against template copy.
Create header: memcpy 24-byte template (FUN_08033018), set u16[7] at 0x0E to negated word-sum, write sector 0 via flash 0x0800d800.

Flush sector 0: read back on-flash header, recompute checksum at struct+0x0E (zero, FUN_0804da24, negate), compare RAM struct vs read-back, write whole 0x1000 sector if different. Exact compare extent is a decompiler artefact (0x400 iterations vs 0x18-byte stack buffer) - UNKNOWN.
Read sector (slot+1)*0x1000, length 0x1000, into buffer pointer stored at struct+0x18.

Deserialise one 0x2C RAM entry from sector stream via game FUN_0804d800: 1B to global, 4B->+0x00, 6B->+0x04, 3B->+0x0C (bit23 sign-extended), 16B->+0x10, then FUN_08048d8c unpacks 5 packed bytes into 10 sub-fields at +0x20.
Game stream-copy (distinct from flash wrapper 0x0800d800): memcpy from cursor at struct+0xD4, cursor += n; if state at struct+0xD8 > 0, cursor skips 1 byte and state clears first.
Unpack 5 stream bytes into 10 bit-fields at entry+0x20 offsets {0,2,5,1,6,3,9,4,7,8} with widths 1/2/5, 3/5, 4/4, 3/5, 5.

caller_chains.trigger_context: Load/init: allocate 0x1000 buffer, identify flash chip. No static caller; reached via unrecovered jump-table/state dispatch.
caller_chains.how_mapped: callgraph.json callee edge plus textual FUN_ scan in decompiled.c; each body read in full.

caller_chains.trigger_context: Load: verify 24-byte header (sum16 zero + URBZ0011 compare). On failure the chain below re-initialises the save blank, matching the PACKET mutation probe at 0x0B.
caller_chains.how_mapped: Textual call scan + body inspection; header layout corroborated by both .sav files and Python sum verification.

caller_chains.trigger_context: Blank re-initialisation after header validation failure: install template header, fix checksum word at 0x0E, write sector 0; then FUN_0804d764 zeroes the buffer and sectors 1-4 are written zeroed.
caller_chains.how_mapped: Textual call scan (callgraph.json lists FUN_0804da48 callers as []); template contents corroborated by identical header bytes in both samples.

caller_chains.trigger_context: Load sectors 1-4: read each 0x1000 sector, validate sum16 zero, deserialise valid blocks into 0x2C-byte RAM entries 0-3, zero invalid entries (FUN_08032fac memset).
caller_chains.how_mapped: callgraph.json + textual scan; flag offsets corroborated by file bytes at 0xCC (00x4 in cap-00, 01x4 in cap-01).

caller_chains.trigger_context: End of load: apply persisted language byte struct+0x0A through the 6-way locale dispatch (FUN_08061a80).
ram_fields_updated: language global (via FUN_08061a80 argument = byte at file offset 0x0A)
caller_chains.how_mapped: Body of FUN_0804d6f0 calls FUN_08061a80(*(u8*)(struct+10)); FUN_08061a80 guards argument < 6 and table-dispatches.

caller_chains.trigger_context: Save flush trigger (no static caller; jump-table dispatched). Mutates header bytes, then flushes sector 0, bracketed by hooks FUN_08068398/FUN_08068368 via FUN_0805ba4c/FUN_0805ba58.
caller_chains.how_mapped: Textual call scan in decompiled.c (callgraph.json lists no caller for 0x0804d74c/0x0804d624 edges consistently); the mutated offsets are exactly the header bytes that differ between the two samples.

caller_chains.trigger_context: Sector-0 flush: read back flash header, recompute checksum, compare, erase/program whole sector via IWRAM trampoline with up to 3 retries in the flash wrapper.
caller_chains.how_mapped: Body inspection of FUN_0804d624 and flash FUN_0800d800; trampoline target (erase/program in RAM) inferred from SDK structure, marked static-only.

fields.name: magic_urbz0011
fields.update_mechanism: Installed from 24-byte ROM template memcpy at header creation; 8-byte compared on every load after header checksum passes.
fields.evidence: FUN_0804d694 8-byte compare loop; FUN_0804da48 template memcpy (FUN_08033018, 0x18 bytes); bytes present in both .sav files.

fields.name: header_const_ff80
fields.update_mechanism: Template constant; only read as part of header checksum cover.
fields.evidence: Identical in both samples; inside FUN_0804d694/FUN_0804da48 24-byte header; semantics unknown.

fields.name: language_id
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_0804d74c stores FUN_08061afc() (current language global) at struct+0x0A on every flush triggered by FUN_0802e5f8; FUN_0804d6f0 passes it to FUN_08061a80 (dispatch if < 6) on load.
fields.evidence: Struct-relative offsets +0x0A in FUN_0804d74c/FUN_0804d6f0; 6 locales match title languages (En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl); exact index-to-language order beyond 0 is untested.

fields.name: header_flag_0x0b
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_0804d74c stores literal 1 at struct+0x0B together with the language byte. Not an incrementing generation counter.
fields.evidence: Writer body sets =1; diff between samples is 0->1 with checksum compensating by -0x100; PACKET probe mutation at this offset is rejected via header checksum, not via a counter check.

fields.name: header_reserved_0x0c
fields.update_mechanism: Template value; covered by header checksum.
fields.evidence: Inside 24-byte header in FUN_0804da48/FUN_0804d694.

fields.name: header_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Zero word, sum 12 u16_le words over 0x00-0x17 with FUN_0804da24, store negation; validator requires total sum == 0.
fields.evidence: Python recomputation matches stored values on both samples exactly; decompiled writer/validator bodies read in full.

fields.name: header_reserved_0x10
fields.update_mechanism: Template value; covered by header checksum.
fields.evidence: Inside 24-byte header.

fields.name: header_sentinel_0x12
fields.update_mechanism: Template constant; covered by header checksum. Sentinel semantics unproven.
fields.evidence: Identical 0xFFFF in both samples inside the templated header.

fields.name: header_reserved_0x14
fields.update_mechanism: Template zeros; end of 24-byte header, covered by header checksum.
fields.evidence: Header length 0x18 used by FUN_0804d694/FUN_0804da48/FUN_0804d624.

fields.name: sector0_buffer_pointer_persisted
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_0804d6f0 stores the FUN_08032e48-allocated 0x1000 buffer pointer at struct+0x18; persisted verbatim because sector 0 is flushed as a raw struct dump (FUN_0804d624). Expected to be overwritten on load.
fields.evidence: Pointer value is an EWRAM address identical in both files; struct+0x18 dereferenced as buffer by FUN_0804d9e4/FUN_0804d938.

fields.name: sector0_reserved_0x1c_0xcb
fields.update_mechanism: No traced accessor; part of the raw sector-0 struct dump.
fields.evidence: Zero in both samples; no decompiled function references struct offsets in this range.

fields.name: sector_valid_flags
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_0804d9b4 writes (FUN_0804da24(sector,0x1000)==0) at struct+0xCC+slot during FUN_0804d938 load; persisted by the next sector-0 flush. Treated as load outputs, not inputs (fuzzing target).
fields.evidence: Exact struct offset +0xCC in two functions; file values change 00->01 per byte between captures in step with sector loading.

fields.name: stream_cursor_persisted
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_0804d938 sets struct+0xD4 = sector buffer pointer and struct+0xD8 = 0 before FUN_08023e3c; game FUN_0804d800 advances the cursor per field read. Persisted verbatim in struct dump.
fields.evidence: Struct offsets +0xD4/+0xD8 in FUN_0804d938 and game FUN_0804d800; cap-01 value is an EWRAM pointer near the +0x18 buffer allocation.

fields.name: stream_state
fields.update_mechanism: Reset to 0 per sector load; if > 0 at a stream read, cursor skips 1 byte and the state is cleared (alignment step).
fields.evidence: FUN_0804d800 game stream body; FUN_0804d938 stores 0 at struct+0xD8.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: XOR 0x01 with no checksum repair (replicates PACKET probe)
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Header sum16 != 0, FUN_0804d694 fails, save re-initialised blank and rewritten.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: XOR 0x01, then repair header checksum at 0x0E
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Save loads; isolates whether byte 0x0B has semantics beyond the checksum gate.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Change one magic byte (U->X), repair header checksum at 0x0E
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Checksum passes but 8-byte magic compare in FUN_0804d694 fails; blank re-initialisation. Proves magic is an independent gate.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set language id to 1,2,3,4,5 in turn, repair header checksum each time
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Boot/UI language changes via FUN_08061a80 6-way dispatch; observed language per value maps the index-to-language table. Value >= 6 tests the <6 guard (no dispatch predicted).

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Change sentinel 0xFFFF to 0x0000, repair header checksum
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If load behaviour is unchanged, 0x12 is a passive template constant; re-initialisation would reveal an un-traced reader.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Zero the EWRAM pointer array at 0x300-0x317
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Header checksum unaffected (outside cover 0x00-0x17). Predicted: save still loads, proving no integrity cover/read of sector-0 payload; a crash or lost progress would prove an un-traced payload reader.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Clear sector-valid flags 01 01 01 01 to 00 00 00 00 in sector 0
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: No load effect predicted: flags are recomputed by FUN_0804d9b4 during load and rewritten on next flush. Persistence of cleared flags would refute the output-only model.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: In sector 1: set byte at 0x1000 to 0x01 and compensating u16 at 0x1FFE to 0xFFFF so sector sum16 stays 0; compare against uncompensated variant
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Uncompensated: entry 0 zeroed by FUN_0804d938. Compensated: FUN_08023e3c deserialises entry 0 from near-zero data; tests whether the compensating word location is arbitrary and whether the stream deserialiser runs.
Predicted no effect if the region is dead weight in the struct dump; any behaviour change promotes it from UNKNOWN and demands a reader trace.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Flip one bit in the persisted IWRAM pointer at 0x87C
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Predicted no effect because load overwrites struct pointers; a crash would show the dumped descriptor table is trusted on load.
No effect predicted; any effect proves an undiscovered second save area in sectors >= 5.

open_questions: Which function writes non-empty sectors 1-4, and where does the compensating sum16 word live inside such a block? No serialiser symmetric to FUN_08023e3c was found among the 278 decompiled functions.
What do the four 0x2C-byte records deserialised from sectors 1-4 represent semantically? Both samples have all four blocks empty (all-zero).
Semantics of sector-0 payload regions at 0x300 (EWRAM pointer array), 0x34A (five 0->1 flags), 0x610 and 0x70C (pointer tables), and 0x730-0x7F7 (ARM-code-shaped bytes), populated only in cap-01.

Exact compare extent in FUN_0804d624: the decompilation counts 0x400 compare iterations against a 0x18-byte stack buffer, so whether flushing is triggered by header-only or full-sector changes is unresolved.
Index-to-language mapping for byte 0x0A beyond the observed value 0; the order of the remaining five locales in FUN_08061a80's dispatch table is untested.
Meaning of header constants 0xFF80 at 0x08 and 0xFFFF at 0x12, and of the pre/post-flush hooks FUN_08068398 and FUN_08068368.
Absolute RAM base address (0x02xxxxxx) of the save struct: _DAT_ literal-pool targets are unrecovered in this decompilation, so only struct-relative offsets are proven.

Is there any integrity protection over the sector-0 payload (0x18-0xFFF)? None was found in code, and a Python counterfactual (mutating 0x300) leaves the header checksum at 0; runtime confirmation is fuzzing target at offset 768.
